answer.report_md:
**画出来要什么**
本页要同时产出两类东西。图6是折线图：紫色 Nominal 与红色 Real 两条带点折线，17 个年份（2007–2023），Y 轴只印 100/110/…/160（起点非零、无单位词），刻度线为虚线横向网格，图例在绘图区下方，标题写在整幅宽的紫色反白横幅里，单位 “(index 2007=100)” 藏在标题括号内，下方另有 Notes 与 Source 两行小字（含 COFOG、AMECO 超链接）。图7实为一张“当作图来编号”的表：6 列（2019–2023 各列的表头分两行“2019”/“% of total”，末列橙底“2019-2023 / percentage point change”），10 行功能分类，含负值 -0.1/-0.3/-1.9，行底纹交替。

**定位一个值难在哪**
以 159（Nominal 2023）为例：图上无任何数值标签，只能按像素在 150 与 160 两条虚线之间读；网格间距 10，5% 容差在此约 ±8，尚可，但同法读 105 时，Real 2015 与 2016 相差不到 1 个单位，容差 ±5 反而无法确定它属于哪一年，行键就可能错配。

**不确定的**
各折线点的精确取值全靠目测；105、110 归属年份为推断。图7末列表头配色是否表示“强调”，以及 Online data code 链接算 Source 还是数据链接，无法确证。

heading.title: Evolution of nominal and real public expenditure on education in the EU-27 (index 2007=100)

all plotted points of both lines

worked_example.why_hard: No printed labels; point sits between the 110 and 120 dashed gridlines, markers overlap the Real line.
Column header is split over two coloured lines; the value is a derived change, not a share.

'Nominal' and 'Real' swatch row drawn below the 2007-2023 tick row
dashed horizontal rules at 100,110...160; no vertical rules in the plot
title ends '(index 2007=100)' and both lines start at 100 in 2007
y ticks read bare '100'...'160'; scale word only in title '(index 2007=100)'
lowest y tick printed is 100, no break glyph drawn on the axis
bordered grid of rows and year columns carrying the caption 'Figure 7. Public expenditure by function'
'-0.1', '-0.3', '-0.4', '-1.9' printed in the 2019-2023 percentage point change column
'2019-2023 percentage point change' header cell filled orange while year headers are red
'Online data code: [gov_10a_exp]' underlined hyperlink on the line under the table

answer.hardest_step_why: 图6全无数值标签，网格每10单位：159、148须像素读；105在Real 2015与2016间仅差半格，容差内无法定年。

examples.quote: Two lines with round markers; y gridlines dashed at 100,110...160; no number printed on any point
examples.why: 每点可达精度不同：靠近网格的110可读准，105、116须内插，布尔式"可读"无法表达。

examples.quote: Figure 6. Evolution of nominal and real public expenditure on education in the EU-27 (index 2007=100)
examples.why: 编号、标题与单位"index 2007=100"挤在同一条紫色横幅里，需拆成独立字段并记录横幅位置。

examples.quote: The lowest y tick reads 100 and the axis carries no unit word, only 100 to 160
examples.why: 轴起点非零、单位仅存于标题括号，现有生成器不会同时控制刻度格式与单位位置。

examples.quote: Figure 7 is a bordered table: rows 'Economic affairs'...'Social protection', columns '2019 % of total' ... '2019-2023 percentage point change'
examples.why: 需生成"表即图"：带编号横幅、两行列头、交替底纹与含负值的派生变化列。

examples.quote: Bold lead-in 'Overall, early signs of a moderate rebound in investment in education are emerging' below Figure 7
examples.why: 整页导出需保留粗体导语与图注、来源行相对表格的位置关系。
